title: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Introduction to computer science and programming in Python, and the social impact of computing.

title: Introduction to C++ and Object-Oriented Programming
description: Object-oriented programming in C++: abstract data types, encapsulation, and memory management with pointers.

title: Data Structures
description: Implementation and analysis of stacks, queues, hash tables, and binary trees, and their use in sorting and searching.

title: Advanced Programming
description: Advanced object-oriented programming, GUI design, graphs, inheritance, polymorphism, and large software projects.

title: Theory of Automata and Languages
description: Finite automata, regular expressions, pushdown automata, context-free languages, Turing machines, and undecidability.

title: Theory of Algorithms
description: Algorithm design and analysis: design strategies, asymptotic notation, P and NP, and approximation algorithms.

title: Computer Graphics
description: Interactive computer graphics, including transformations and curve and surface approximation.

title: Programming Languages
description: Comparison of major classes of programming languages, with a focus on functional programming.

title: Computer Security
description: Security principles, operating system security, access control, memory safety, and web and network security.

title: Introduction to Data Science and Machine Learning
description: Data preprocessing, visualization, feature selection, machine learning algorithms, clustering, and model evaluation.

title: The Design and Management of Software
description: Best practices for designing and building large software projects, with a quarter-long team project.

title: Computer Simulation
description: Probability distributions, Monte Carlo methods, and simulation models such as queues and scheduling.

title: Optimization I
description: Unconstrained and constrained optimization (Newton's method, Lagrangians, KKT conditions), convex programming, and dynamic programming.

title: Optimization II
description: Local and global optimization algorithms: gradient descent, the simplex method, and metaheuristics.

title: Computational Complexity
description: Turing machines, undecidability, complexity classes, reductions, and P versus NP.

title: Advanced Theory of Algorithms
description: Advanced algorithm design, with an emphasis on graph algorithms, network flows, and social network analysis.

title: Data Privacy and Algorithmic Fairness
description: The theory of data privacy and algorithmic fairness, with a research project.

title: Numerical Analysis
description: Numerical methods for linear systems, integration, approximation, and nonlinear equations, with error analysis.

title: Applied Cryptography
description: Hash functions, stream ciphers, secret sharing, key management, and cryptocurrencies.

title: Advanced Machine Learning
description: Neural networks and their optimization, CNN, RNN and Transformer models, reinforcement learning, and ethics.

title: Data Mining
description: Finding patterns in large datasets: association rules, text mining, and anomaly detection, using SQL and Python.

title: Calculus and Analytic Geometry I
description: Limits and differentiation, with methods and applications of differentiation.

title: Calculus and Analytic Geometry II
description: Further applications of differentiation, integration, the fundamental theorem of calculus, and methods of integration.

title: Calculus and Analytic Geometry III
description: Taylor series, vectors, quadric surfaces, partial derivatives, and optimization of multivariable functions.

title: Calculus and Analytic Geometry IV
description: Vector functions, line and multiple integrals, flux, and the divergence and Stokes' theorems.

title: Discrete Mathematics
description: Predicate logic, proof methods, sets, functions, modular arithmetic, induction, combinatorics, recursion, and relations.

title: Linear Algebra
description: Vector spaces, linear transformations, matrix algebra, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and inner products.

title: Probability and Statistics I
description: Probability spaces, random variables and distributions, expectation, and the central limit theorem. MATH 14 is a pre- or corequisite.

title: A Survey of Geometry
description: Euclidean, projective, and non-Euclidean geometry.

title: Probability and Statistics II
description: Confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, maximum likelihood estimation, ANOVA, and regression.

title: Theory of Numbers
description: Divisibility, primes, congruences, and Diophantine equations.

title: Combinatorics
description: Permutations, generating functions, inclusion-exclusion, and Polya counting.

title: Graph Theory
description: Planarity, trees, directed graphs, graph algorithms, and networks.

title: Cryptography
description: Classical ciphers, AES, RSA, discrete logarithms, elliptic curves, and digital signatures.

title: Physics for Scientists and Engineers I
description: Mechanics, from measurement and vectors through gravitation and Kepler's laws, with a weekly lab.

title: General Chemistry I: Bonding and Energy
description: Chemical structure, bonding, stoichiometry, and an introduction to thermodynamics, with a weekly lab.

title: Environmental Biology L&L
description: How humans affect life on Earth, through the principles of evolution and ecology.

title: Introduction to Earth Systems L&L
description: How geologic, oceanic, hydrologic, and climate systems interact, and how human action changes them.

title: Introduction to Programming
description: Overview of computing and program design in PHP and C: variables, control flow, arrays, strings and functions, in a Linux environment. Includes the CSEN 10L lab (1 unit).

title: Advanced Programming
description: The C language: pointers, arrays, strings, structures, dynamic memory, file I/O, recursion and threads, in the Unix environment. Includes the CSEN 11L lab (1 unit).

title: Abstract Data Types and Data Structures
description: Abstract data types; stacks, queues, lists, trees, hashing and graphs; sorting; Big-O analysis; introduction to C++ classes. Includes the CSEN 12L lab (1 unit).

title: Object-Oriented Programming and Advanced Data Structures
description: Object-oriented design and the specification and implementation of lists, stacks, queues, maps and graphs, with inheritance, templates and iterators. Includes the CSEN 79L lab (1 unit).

title: Microprocessor System Design
description: Design of microprocessor-based embedded systems: assembly programming, input/output devices, low-level timing control, and lab projects. Includes the ECEN 120L lab (1 unit).

title: Introduction to Embedded Systems
description: Computer organization, assembly programming, and C for embedded systems. Includes the CSEN 20L lab (1 unit).

title: Introduction to Logic Design
description: Boolean logic minimization, combinational and sequential circuits, memory, and HDL design on FPGAs. Includes the ECEN 21L lab (1 unit).

title: Computer Networks
description: Switching, transport, routing, and link-layer protocols, and network security. Includes the CSEN 146L lab (1 unit).

title: Web Development
description: Building web applications with HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, and XML. Includes the CSEN 161L lab (1 unit).

title: Operating Systems
description: Process management, synchronization, memory, I/O, and file systems. Includes the CSEN 177L lab (1 unit).

title: Introduction to Database Systems
description: Relational database design: ER diagrams, normalization, SQL, indexing, and transactions. Includes the CSEN 178L lab (1 unit).

title: Introduction to Computer Forensics
description: Identifying, preserving, and extracting electronic evidence, and investigating intrusions. Includes the lab, CSEN 152L.

title: Artificial Intelligence
description: Foundations of AI: problem solving, knowledge and reasoning, neural networks, and learning. Includes the lab, CSEN 166L.
